title: New MSFS Marketplace Drop: Legendary GA Hubs, Coastal Escapes & Massive European Upgrades!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just loaded up a phenomenal collection of diverse destinations this week! Whether you want to land at the legendary home of general aviation, tackle challenging island approaches in the Mediterranean, or explore beautifully updated regional gateways in Southeast Asia, there is an adventure waiting for your virtual hangar.

In this comprehensive marketplace breakdown, we split today's major releases into three logical groups to see which environments genuinely deserve a spot on your virtual flight logs:

✈️ ESSENTIAL GENERAL AVIATION HUBS: We kick things off with the ultimate destination for GA pilots—Oshkosh Wittman Regional Airport (KOSH) by UK2000 Scenery. Located in Winnebago County, Wisconsin, this historical field is beautifully modeled with custom terminal interiors, detailed maintenance hangars, and iconic airport signage. Note that you'll need the free UK2000 common library from the marketplace to get this legendary hub fully rendered!

🌏 INTERNATIONAL COASTAL & REGIONAL GATEWAYS: Next, we head over to the Mediterranean to look at Sitia Public Airport (LGST) by MM Simulations, a stunning summer vacation getaway tucked away on the eastern coast of Crete, Greece, complete with a fully modeled tower interior and animated terminal details. From there, we journey to Indonesia to explore Bajawa Airport (WATB) by Goody Sim on Flores Island—a vital regional gateway featuring realistic PBR materials, custom terminal architecture, and highly optimized ground layouts.

🇺🇸 EUROPEAN LANDMARKS & NIGHT ENHANCEMENTS: Finally, we unpack a massive VFR upgrade for Germany with FSDG’s Landmarks of Germany: North Rhine-Westphalia, adding over 1,500 individual custom objects including castles, bridges, and television towers. To wrap up the tour, we look at the Paris Region Enhanced Road Lights package, a specialized utility designed to overhaul and crisp up the night lighting footprints across the entire city of lights.

Which of these environments are you adding to your flight routes first? Are you setting up a flight camp down in Greece, or are you downloading the German VFR landmarks right away? Let me know in the comments below!

If this structured marketplace breakdown helped you plan your next route, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism and scenery updates!
